record.scope: GLAMEOW (1 star) and PURUGLY (2 stars), the queued units.
record.summary: Confuse-and-enrage the cast target. Duration = round(baseDuration x (1 + caster AP/100) x critPower if the cast crit), baseDuration 1500 ms at 1 star, 2000 at 2, 3000 at 3, 5000 at 4+ (GLAMEOW 1500, PURUGLY 2000, raw before AP). The same duration is passed to triggerConfusion and then triggerRage. Confusion is skipped if the target is already confused, has runeProtect or the confusion-immunity effect; otherwise it is lengthened by Sandstorm (x1.3) and shortened by the duration-reduction helper (Swift Swim / Hydration / Water Veil / Surge Surfer, Odd Keystone). Rage has none of those guards or reductions: the target becomes enraged (protect cleared, +80 speed) or, if already enraged, only a longer duration replaces its timer. No damage is dealt.

targeting.who: the cast target only (an enemy chosen by the normal attack targeting; requiresTarget is true)

effects.description: no damage, shield, heal or movement: the ability only applies confusion then rage to the cast target, both with the same requested duration; details in statusEffects
effects.resolution: see statusEffects: confusion is guarded and reduced, rage is not

declaredRaw.note: raw base before AP and crit; GLAMEOW 1500, PURUGLY 2000

statusEffects.scaling: AP once (inside the ability: x (1 + AP/100)); triggerConfusion is called with apBoost false so it does not apply AP again; crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT); then in triggerConfusion Sandstorm x1.3, the shared duration reductions, Math.round
statusEffects.guards: not applied if the target is already confused (the old timer is kept, not refreshed), has status.runeProtect, or has IMMUNITY_CONFUSION; Persim Berry is eaten and the Psyduck passive gains 100 AP only when the confusion is actually applied. Rage is applied regardless of whether confusion was
statusEffects.combatEffect: a confused unit picks its target with getTargetWhenConfused (nearest within range+1; allies also eligible when a 50% luck-adjusted roll fails); when confusion ends the unit's target is cleared
statusEffects.rawVsApplied: requested = the rounded duration above; applied = after Sandstorm and reductions, rounded again, stored in confusionCooldown

declaredRaw.note: raw base; requested duration before AP/crit

statusEffects.scaling: the requested duration is stored as is: AP/crit were applied in the ability; no Sandstorm and no duration-reduction helper; no runeProtect guard
statusEffects.guards: if already enraged: only replaces the timer when the new duration is longer, no second +80 speed; the unit-wide enrage delay (35000 ms) can make the unit permanently enraged, in which case the Swagger timer does not end the rage
statusEffects.combatEffect: on first application: protect is cleared, sleep and freeze cooldowns are halved (floor), speed +80 through addSpeed (apBoost 0, so only the target's Big Eater Belt / Twist Band helpers and the MAX_SPEED clamp can change it) and removed with addSpeed(-80) at expiry; while enraged the unit deals double damage, receives half healing and half shield and cannot gain protect

starBehavior.note: duration table indexed by the caster's stars (pokemon.stars - 1) with fallback 5000; entries 3000 and 5000 are not reached by these units' star counts. maxPP 100 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None: no area, no distance condition beyond the normal attack range for casting.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept by the ability. Recasting on a target that is still confused leaves the confusion timer unchanged; on a target that is still enraged it extends the rage timer only if the new duration is longer. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested duration: 1500 (GLAMEOW) / 2000 (PURUGLY) ms raw base; after the ability's own AP and crit scaling it is round(base x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower]). Applied confusion duration = that value after Sandstorm x1.3 and the shared reductions, rounded; applied rage duration = that value unchanged (only stored if the target is not enraged or the value is longer). The +80 speed is requested through addSpeed and its applied change can differ with the target's Big Eater Belt / Twist Band and the speed clamp.
